description: Mary's Room stage 4 fix (concept link): ColourProperty -categorised_as-> one of Mary's four pre-exposure research concepts (frozen hue4 classes red/purple, yellow, green, blue). ColourConcept prototypes are DATA compiled at generation time from Mary's research only: the frozen unique-hue anchor stimuli of results/marys_room_broad_armA.json (recomputed from CIE 2006 2-deg LMS, spectral_forward.load_lms, and asserted equal), white-normalised X' = X/X_E by the CIE LMS of equal-energy white, prototype = unit (L'-M', S'-(L'+M')/2). Rule cc_link: descriptor r_ch = p_ch/pa_ch (anchor-relative = white-normalised; the anchor is the scene max/white), d = (r_L-r_M, r_S-(r_L+r_M)/2); angle to each prototype = Atan2(|d x u|, d.u); link the Argmin, with concept_angle_deg and concept_margin_deg on the property. Refusals (concept_status): 'achromatic' (d exactly (0,0)), 'tied' (margin 0), 'no_anchor' (some pa < 1). No tuned constant. The link quality measures the Mary gap (CIE-observer research vs this eye's Gaussian catches). Flag ColourConceptParams.enabled, OFF by default (sec 9). See tools/build_colour_concept_link_seed.py.

microtheory.name: colour_concept_link
microtheory.description: perceived colour property -> Mary's research hue concept

rules.name: cc_link
rules.comment: Pre-exposure research applied to a post-exposure property: CP -categorised_as-> the ColourConcept with the smallest angle between CP's white-normalised opponent descriptor d = (r_L - r_M, r_S - (r_L + r_M)/2), r = p/pa, and the concept's unit prototype. Records the angle and the margin to the runner-up.

rules.name: cc_achromatic
rules.comment: REFUSAL: a descriptor exactly at (0, 0) (r_L = r_M = r_S, e.g. the anchor surface) has no hue direction; no link.

rules.name: cc_tied
rules.comment: REFUSAL: two concepts exactly equidistant (margin 0); no link, no tie-break guess.

rules.name: cc_no_anchor
rules.comment: REFUSAL: some anchor channel pa < 1 -- the anchor-relative descriptor is undefined.
